test_BYearBegin_offset_arithmetic: test the BYearBegin offset by adding it to datetime objects and verifying the next business year start date
test_BYearEnd_offset_arithmetic: test the BYearEnd offset by adding it to datetime objects and verifying the last business year end date
test_BYearBegin_invalid_month: test BYearBegin raises ValueError when month parameter is outside the valid range of 1 to 12
test_BYearEnd_invalid_month: test BYearEnd raises ValueError when month parameter is outside the valid range of 1 to 12
test_BYearEnd_is_on_offset: test BYearEnd is_on_offset by checking whether a datetime falls on a business year end date
